c1.name: Somber Freeze
c1.descriptionRaw: The Traveler regenerates 5 Elemental Energy when they deal Stellar Glimmer DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
c1.description: The Traveler regenerates 5 Elemental Energy when they deal Stellar Glimmer DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

c2.name: Frostfall Reverberation
c2.descriptionRaw:
The active character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 for 5s when an opponent is hit by an <color=#FFD780FF>ice crystal</color> fired by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color>.
Additionally, when a character affected by the aforementioned effect triggers a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, the Elemental Mastery boost described above will be increased to 120 for its duration.

c4.name: Enduring Ice
c4.descriptionRaw: The duration of the <color=#FFD780FF>Frostpierce Star</color> created by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color> is increased by 25%.

c6.name: Brumal Grimfrost
c6.descriptionRaw: Every stack of {LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostglow</color>{/LINK} consumed when using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}Frostbound Javelin{/LINK}</color> increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other party members by 5% for 15s. A maximum 40% increase can be obtained in this way.
